text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Everything in front of me is blurring. My nose won't stop running either.
...Why am I crying, too?)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because the President rejected
the "absolute" I believed in?)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(――...No. That's... not it.
Because the President's eyes back then were――)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuuugh......!
Uwaaaaahhhhhh......!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Daaaaaaughhhhhh!!

—When Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi returns,
where should I even begin?

"The clock points to 8:00 PM.
It is almost time for our appointment."
choice_data_list: (…Tsuyoshi will be back soon)

text_block_list.text:
"What do you want to do?"
...I shake my head, banishing the thought.
Can I really just brush it off with a question like that?

"‘What do you want to do?’
...I shook my head to clear the thought away.
Was it really okay to leave it at such a simple question?"
(CLANK!!)
choice_data_list: Whoa, shoot! My PC is—!!

text_block_list.text:
"I pick up the laptop that slid off my lap.
This is terrible... If it's broken, I'm ruined!
All my data up to now is on here!"

I quickly booted up my PC to check the data.
The latest files, and the past ones just in case—
choice_data_list: ...This brings back memories.

text_block_list.text: Training Menu Leading Up to the Debut Race
"For Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi to deliver her best performance in her debut race."
Looking at it now, it's quite crude. But even back then, I gave it everything I had.

For her sake, since she always tends to overwork herself,
I wanted to show her what 'proper effort' looks like.
choice_data_list: Still, back then...

text_block_list.text:
I recalled how she had injured both of her legs
after the debut race.

"...My hands were trembling back then.
Letting my imagination run wild with terrifying futures."
Even in a situation that was hard for us to watch, she, the one who had actually run—
"—Never stopping, always looking forward to the next chance."
Even during the Satsuki Sho.
Though plagued by mysterious symptoms, she immediately began fighting with all her might to get back on her feet.

Even during the Nippon Derby,
she never gave up, despite ending up hospitalized.

And all of her peers are exceptionally talented.
The training gap between her and the others widened even further.

Everything was against me.
It was full of situations that made me want to give up, and yet...
choice_data_list: (Even so, she—!)

text_block_list.text: —I've decided on the words I want to say.

I quietly close the laptop and put it in my bag.
Now all that's left is to wait for her by the entrance.
choice_data_list: (I have to at least tell her this.)

text_block_list.text: Even if she has gained something and lost something in facing the one she admired.
choice_data_list: (――I have to tell her at least this.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I have returned.
choice_data_list: ...Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Um, Trainer...
...Could you teach me?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The President told me...
that the "absolute" I speak of does not exist.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not an Umamusume with a guaranteed, "absolute" future like the President,
then I'll just have to fight in my own way—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I don't hold such 'absolutes' either, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as an "absolute"
that decides what the future will be.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I—
I just can't help but believe that "absolute" exists!!
choice_data_list: ...If there truly is an "absolute"

text_block_list.text: I look back on Symboli Rudolf's history as told by Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi. From that, one can say—
choice_data_list: Rudolf has "absolutely" always beaten her rivals

text_block_list.text: "No matter what dire straits you find yourself in, even if you are forced to taste defeat once."

"Defeating his opponent once more to prove his own supreme strength was
the 'Emperor,' Symboli Rudolf."
choice_data_list: That doesn't change the facts, does it?
That doesn't change the facts, does it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, not one bit. The President always had her revenge.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, that's true.
...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.text:
The word 'absolute' itself seems to mean
something that remains unchanged, no matter what,
under any circumstances.
If we're talking about taking those words literally, it's about the past I've spent watching her by her side.
—That is the reason I can say these words.
choice_data_list: Then you've "definitely" worked hard all this time too.
Then you've "definitely" worked hard all this time too.

text_block_list.text:
Even after her debut race.
Even during the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby.
Her spirit never once broke.
The despair of seeing your hard-won time improvements reset after being forced to rest—she refused to be defeated by that either.
choice_data_list: The you I've watched was "absolutely" strong!!
The you that I've seen was *undeniably* strong!!

text_block_list.text:
"Her time improved, too!
Her physique has been built up significantly
compared to before her debut!"
And above all else—
choice_data_list: The fact that you never gave up will never change!
The fact that you never gave up in the past will never change!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: That's why... I can't help but believe it.

text_block_list.text:
...Believing in something is difficult.
Nothing is more uncertain than the future.
You never know when your efforts might go to waste.

Even so, the fact that you gave it your all doesn't change.
Because you have a past of absolute accomplishment, there is a future beyond it.

Because the certainty called the past existed,
one can believe in the possibility called the future.
choice_data_list: Certainties do exist—I believe in your potential...!
Certainties do exist—I believe in your potential...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Because absolute certainties do exist.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
…………――Because there was an "absolute" in me,
Trainer chose me――

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Believe me, please...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...To have been believed in all this time...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuuuuugh~~~...!
Uuuuuuuugh~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was completely insisting
that it was impossible until just recently~~...!

...I gently stay by her side
as she roughly wipes away her tears.

Seeing her cry like that was a complete contrast
to the mature demeanor she showed earlier.
—And yet, it somehow felt true to who she is.
(Tug!)

Having both my arms pulled forward out of nowhere...
made me slow to react.
choice_data_list: Wha... Tsuyoshi!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Uuuugh...
Please don't look at me right now~~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, looking back at who I was until yesterday...
...is just way too embarrassing~!
choice_data_list: ...It's nothing to be ashamed of. Not at all.

text_block_list.text: I wait right there until she calms down, burying her face into me with all her might.

—Neither Umamusume nor ourselves.
No one has an absolute certainty right from the start.
Only that which steadily builds upon the past, piece by piece, until it becomes unshakable, can truly be called "absolute."

And since an absolute exists in the past,
then for our future—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Continuing prep for the Kikuka Sho.
That's what you want to do, isn't it, Tsurumaru-san?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then I shall prepare my resolve for that direction!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...However, no matter how much you prepare, there are times when things don't turn out the way you hoped.
Let us never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
I think that's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because, if 'absolute' belongs to the past,
then in a future without 'absolutes', what awaits is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“—Because it's nothing more than a 'possibility'
that anything could truly come true!”

And thus, the night deepened at summer training camp.
Summer came to an end, and autumn arrived.
...Autumn, bringing the 'Kikuka Sho', is here!!
